title: Cocktails & Canvases at 122 | Holiday Margarita Edition
description: Join a guided painting night with a holiday theme, where you paint, unwind, and enjoy a charcuterie cup with good company. No experience is needed, and all painting supplies, instruction, and the charcuterie cup are included with your ticket. Cocktails are available to buy from The 122 Lounge but are not included. Only 15 seats are available, so register through the ticket form; plan to arrive at 6 PM, as painting begins at 6:15 PM.
address: 122 S Main St, Joplin, MO 64801-2306, United States, Joplin, MO
